svg.title: Count warp addresses at a declared service boundary
svg.text: Count warp addresses at a declared service boundary
32 scalar reads × 4 bytes; contiguous aligned start
128 distinct useful bytes → 4 requested sectors. Shift by 4 bytes → 5 sectors.
32 scalar reads; stride 8 elements between lanes
128 distinct useful bytes → 32 requested sectors, covering 1,024 bytes.
Six valid scalar reads; mask the tail before access
24 distinct useful bytes → 1 sector at offset 0, but 2 sectors at offset 28 bytes.
Assumptions: aligned base, 32-byte sectors, scalar words, valid addresses and explicit active masks.
These are instruction-level coverage counts, not measured DRAM bytes or runtime speedups.
